thesis_validity._comment: Signal-validity engine (kairos_thesis_validity.py) backstops. Hold/sell is driven by live signal validity, NOT elapsed time — these days are LAST-RESORT review flags only and never trigger a sell on their own. watch_backstop_days: a position held longer with no validity sell signal is force-flagged WATCH. scrutiny_backstop_days: held longer → a HOLD is downgraded to WATCH (elevated scrutiny). backstop_days: per-signal review horizons (these replaced the old hold-window TRIGGERS the prompt referenced as hot_*_hold_days, which never existed as top-level fields in this codebase — the real time-windows live under reallocation.signal_hold_windows and exits.conviction_decay.decay_days, both still used by checkpoints/liberation/arbiter and intentionally left intact).

ollama._comment: screen_model: phi4-mini ~2.3GB, better instruction following than llama3.2 for Tier 1 batch classification. reason_model: qwen3.6:35b-a3b ~23GB MoE (~3B active per token), upgraded from qwen3:30b-a3b — next-gen Qwen3.6 family, stronger routing/filtering. qwen3:30b-a3b kept installed as fallback pending validation. Load/unload architecture means screener and router never share RAM simultaneously. thinking mode disabled in kairos_ollama.py ask().

claude._comment: Claude Code CLI invoked via subprocess for Phase 2 reasoning. Set cli_path if claude is not on PATH. model: claude-sonnet-5 (June 2026, intro pricing thru Aug 31). effort_*: Sonnet 5 effort levels per call type — decision=high (main trading JSON), router=medium (task dispatch), thesis=low (YES/NO invalidation check). API default is high; passed via output_config={'effort': ...}.

slack._comment: Slack Bot API (slack_sdk). Values are channel IDs. kairos-alerts=C0AQA4ZH0P2, kairos-reports=C0AP9F2P10T, kairos-commands=C0APFSF09U2, kairos-log=C0APKEES12Q, kairos-trades=, kairos-watchlist= (was #new-channel).

options_signal._comment: HOT-OPTIONS thresholds. vol/OI spike, IV rank percentile, call/put skew. DTE range for front-month expiry selection.

confluence._comment: NLV-based conviction sizing. Tiers set position as % of Net Liquidation Value. Guardrails: 1% cash reserve (commissions + settlement), 25% sector max, 10% single position max.

tier0_filter._comment: Tier 0 pre-filter. Data source switched from Finnhub profile2 (was returning missing market_cap/avg_volume, and the /stock/candle endpoint was returning no data at all) to a single bulk yfinance call — fast (~21s for 622 tickers) and reliable. check_thresholds also fixed: a threshold of 0 now genuinely disables that check instead of still requiring the field to exist, which is what let the broken market_cap field silently reject the whole universe even at threshold=0. All activity thresholds (volume, 5d change) intentionally stay at 0 — Tier 0 is a sanity floor only (dead tickers, sub-$5 price); filtering on price/volume activity here would exclude quiet pre-move setups before HOT-INSIDER/HOT-CONGRESS ever see them, which defeats the point of the system. Re-enabled 2026-07-01.

reallocation._comment: Reallocation parameters: minimum conviction scores, hold time guard (5 TRADING days), max loss threshold (-15% = block sells down >15%), max tax cost threshold ($1000), max thesis review age in hours. signal_hold_windows is retained for arbiter / ml_thesis checkpoints / commander but NO LONGER gates liberation (Exit Architecture v2 replaced the runway gate with conviction decay).

trailing_stop._ipo_note: Young IPOs whip-saw on day-1/2 noise. For the first ipo_window_days HOLDING days, the trailing-stop trail (and thus the intraday backstop = trail x intraday_mult) is widened by ipo_multiplier so normal IPO volatility does not trigger a profit-capture exit. IPO identity is read from kairos_ipo_cache.json (detected set), NOT the signal tag, which is lost once a position is held.
trailing_stop._target_armed_note: TARGET-ARMED trail (backtest-verified, +31.6pts over flat tiers on n=49): no trail arms until peak_gain_pct reaches the position's own logged thesis target (predicted_return_pct from thesis_predictions); THEN a flat trail_pct trail arms, harvesting only the give-back on the SURPLUS above what the thesis promised. Falls back to the flat tiers above for any ticker with no logged target. enabled=false ships as a no-op; J flips true after reviewing dry-run output.
trailing_stop._profit_floor_note: Once ANY trail is armed, allowed retreat is capped at (peak - profit_floor_pp) so an armed winner can never exit below ~breakeven+floor. Added 2026-07-02 after giveback analysis: target-armed positions with single-digit peaks had backstops wider than their peaks (guaranteed-loss exits). 0 disables.

conviction_decay._decay_note: decay_days are now MAXIMUM windows — the validity engine extends high-scoring positions and accelerates low-scoring ones. A HOT-EARNINGS position scoring 90/100 on validity decays 2.5x slower than the 10-day window (effective ~25d); one scoring <35 decays ~5x faster (effective ~2d). Validity tiers (kairos_exits.conviction_decay_score): >=75 -> dd x2.5, >=65 -> x1.5, 45-64 neutral, <45 -> x0.4, <35 -> x0.2. Modulation only applies when a validity_cache is warmed for the cycle (kairos_thesis_validity.warm_validity_cache); with no cache, decay stays purely time-based (unchanged legacy behavior).

exits._comment: Exit Architecture v2 — five-condition exit engine (kairos_exits.py). stop_loss: signal-aware closing % + 1.5x intraday backstop; the regime threshold (kairos_stoploss.STOP_LOSS_THRESHOLDS) is applied as a tighter-of-the-two floor in RISK-OFF/EXTREME-FEAR. trailing_stop: peak-gain tiers [min_gain, trail%] (15/30/50 -> 8/10/12), closing eval + 1.5x intraday backstop. tax_gate: delay non-stop exits within 30d of the 12-mo anniversary while profitable; exempt if >20% retreat from peak. conviction_decay: per-signal linear decay of confluence base points over decay_days; below liberation_threshold a position is liberation-eligible (replaces the old hold-window runway gate). reentry: no-higher-price guard unless a genuinely new signal fired. hot_reversion_time_gate: the ONLY time-based exit (7d). close_window_et: the cycle landing in this ET window is treated as the 'close' for closing-price stops.

hot_catalyst._comment: HOT-CATALYST long-options-only (buy calls/puts, never sell premium). dry_run=true simulates+logs all orders (override with dry_run=false AND --no-dry-run). Risk: 15% portfolio max in options, 2.5% NLV per position, 50% hard stop, 100% take-profit, close/roll at 21 DTE, no entry on earnings day, 30-60 DTE preferred at entry. Delta bands: default 30-40 (Setup1 pre-catalyst), reversion 40-50 (Setup2 post-crush), flow 25-35 (Setup3 unusual flow). Setup1: enter 7-21d before catalyst when iv_rank<=0.50 (underpriced vol). Setup2: trigger on >=10% drop over <=3 days; thesis-driven direction (reclaim/hold gap low=intact->calls, lower lows=broken->puts). Setup3: follow unusual flow only if no earnings within 5 days.

hot_ipo._comment: HOT-IPO pipeline (tracker, capital reservation, Day-1 executor, lock-up tracker). dry_run=true is the shared first lock for the whole IPO pipeline; real reservations/orders/arming also require each module's --no-dry-run (two-lock). lockup: 180-day lock-up expiration short tracker. Scores the post-IPO short thesis when within scoring_window_days of expiration (performance/valuation vs IPO price + insider concentration from S-1 + timing, 0-10). Arms theses scoring >= score_threshold whose stock is up >= min_perf_since_ipo_pct since IPO; armed rows route to HOT-CATALYST as long-PUT setups. Even when armed, hot_catalyst.dry_run still gates whether a real put is placed.
